name: GenerateInfrastructureWorkbook
transaction_boundary: short enqueue UnitOfWork only; artifact generation/verifying/publish occurs in INFRA_WORKBOOK_EXPORT_V1 job outside writer lock
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> receipt -> durable_jobs insert -> audit -> commit
post_commit_work: INFRA_WORKBOOK_EXPORT_V1 allocates/checkpoints one immutable export_id before temp creation, writes/verifies/publishes the workbook according to SOMA_INFRASTRUCTURE_WORKBOOK_V1, then records exactly one infrastructure_workbook_exports row; crash/cancellation behavior is governed by jobs/workbook-jobs.json and never treats an operator-managed published file as rollback/cleanup authority
